author: reek
body: What this pins is that the header parses -- that a chapter may cite, quote, pin a trusted key and set a floor in the same breath -- and that the trusted-key form lexes and means what it says: a fingerprint, the public key its signatures verify against, and a score. The quoted work is admitted because THIS source vouches for its signer, and doubled below is the chapter's own, untouched by any of it.

author: reek
body: It also pins that quotes, trusting and above are real keywords: this chapter would not lex without them.
